author: reek
body: Authentication and session management. Passwords are hashed with HMAC-SHA256 using a per-store salt. Sessions are time-limited tokens stored in the sessions table.

author: reek
body: hmac-sha256-hex takes byte lists, not Text, so both arguments cross the encoding boundary here. `text-to-bytes` is the conversion; passing Text straight in was a type error that had never compiled, so no password hash this chapter produces has ever been computed.
